conversation.user: I'm scoping a backyard office with 420 sq. ft. of wall area at 10 inches.
conversation.assistant:
A backyard office with 420 square feet of exterior wall area at 10 inches (about 25 cm) thickness will require roughly 10 to 11 cubic meters of hemp-lime material. For a clean and speedy DIY build at that scale, I usually recommend using pre-cast blocks so you don't have to deal with on-site formwork and wet-mixing. Just keep in mind that these calculator numbers are planning estimates, not stamped engineering or permit advice.
